One world. One game. Your voice.
This July, changemakers and decision-makers meet at the United Nations in New York — right before the World Cup Final — to talk about young people, sport, and well-being.
And we want to hear from you. What you share here will shape the discussions, the debates, and what comes next.
Collect as many gold coins as you can. Every answer is a coin, every coin carries your voice onto the world stage.
Ready? Let's play.
